2.  The Petitioners in the above Petitions claim that they are selling cooked Vada Pav/Samosa/Pav/Bhajiya/Cutlet and Farsan 2/3 905&906-wp.2492.97.2018.doc respectively in a hawking zone viz Opposite Janseva Bank, Sector - 1, Near Charkop Market, Swami Samarth Kadsidheshwar Marg, Charkop, Kandivali (West), Mumbai - 400 067.
Both the Petitioners claim that they are doing this business since last more that 15 years.

Therefore, they claim that they are entitled to protection in terms of the decision laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Maharashtra Ekta Hawkers Union and Another v/s Municipal Corporation, Greater Mumbai and Others1, as well as Judgment of the Division Bench of this Court (Coram:B.R.Gavai and M.S.Karnik,
JJ.) in the case of Azad Hawkers Union and Others v/s Union of India and Ors.2 Jitendra Jayantilal Rughani vs The Municipal Corporation Of Greater ... on 19 December, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/189315598/
1 3.

Till the next date, the Respondent - Corporation shall not evict the Petitioners, subject to the Petitioners filing an undertaking in this Court in a week, that they will not cook food items in the place where they are doing business.

A copy of the said undertaking shall also be submitted to the concerned department of the M.C.G.M.
6.
